name: cpdevtools
description: Layered skills for TypeScript, Angular and backend work: universal conventions plus per-project library plugins.

plugins.name: typescript
plugins.description: Conventions for TypeScript workspaces: .ts configs, one language per workspace, folders by feature, root verb.noun scripts, formatter-clean generators, required behaviour built in.

plugins.name: angular
plugins.description: Angular conventions layered on Angular's defaults: separate component files, smart/presentational components, component-tree DI, no data- attributes.

plugins.name: angular-signal-store
plugins.description: NgRx signalStore conventions: global vs component stores, store features, layered stores. Enable in projects that use @ngrx/signals.

plugins.name: angular-material
plugins.description: Angular Material conventions: a custom look is a Material theme; Material components and --mat-sys-* tokens first. Enable in projects that use @angular/material.

plugins.name: domain-packages
plugins.description: Domain packages with layers (provide, feature, ui, data, model, testing) and simple libraries, enforced by Sheriff. Enable in workspaces built that way.

plugins.name: cpdevtools-gitflow
plugins.description: Commits, branches, versions and releases in workspaces built on the cpdevtools git-flow template.
